thread:
Sam: Heads-up — I'm prototyping an auditing-first approach for routing decisions when Dedicated tenants spill to Hosted. Need quick opinions on console UX and telemetry schema.
Maria: +1. Important we show WHY a request bounced to hosted (capacity vs policy) not just that it did.
Kevin: Concern: some customers treat "spill_to_hosted" as a hard no. We need deterministic reject vs spill behaviour per tenant flag.
Anya: UX idea: in Routes > Tenant view show a compact history row: [time] [decision]=hosted|dedicated|rejected, reason, model_variant. Click expands to raw event.
Josh: Telemetry should emit a single canonical event: routing.decision with fields: tenant_id, decision, reason, capacity_snapshot, model_variant, route_path, fallback_chain. Also surface a trace_id for cross-service joins.
Sam: sketch of policy config I'm testing (console + API):
```json
{
  "tenant_policy": {
    "isolation": "strict|soft",
    "spill_allowed": true,
    "spill_preference": ["same-region-dedicated","hosted-same-region","hosted-any-region"],
    "preferred_variants": ["quant-fp16","float16"],
    "audit_level": "full"
  }
}
```
Kevin: We need a strict flag that causes 403 at gateway before any RPC hits host. Otherwise customers could leak prompts to hosted infra.
Ops: agree. Implementation note: gateway can check tenant_policy.isolation == "strict" and return 403 + telemetry event routing.decision=rejected:policy.
Tim: API-level header suggestion: X-Client-Routing-Decision: prefer-hosted|prefer-dedicated|strict-isolation. That helps for quick experiments without changing tenant config.
Maria: Console should let ops preview what a tenant's requests would do (dry-run) — show percentage that would have spilled in last 24h and sample traces. UI toggle: "simulate spillover".
Josh: For alerts, propose: Alert when spill_rate > 2% for > 5m for a dedicated cluster AND average latency on hosted fallback > 200ms over baseline. Alert should attach last 10 routing.decision events.
Infra-bot: deploy: routing-audit-schema v1 -> prod (canary 5%) :rocket:
Sam: Permission model: only ops+sec can flip strict-isolation. Product can toggle spill_preference ordering. We should log actor_id with every tenant_policy change.
Kevin: We should also display in tenant console: a human-readable warning "This tenant has strict isolation — all spill attempts will be blocked."
Anya: UX nit: don't show too many raw events by default. Show an aggregation row + a single expandable raw view per hour. Keep console perf snappy.
Ops: Race condition: if quota exhaustion and simultaneous throttle decision, ensure single source of truth for final decision. Josh — can routing.decision be produced atomically at the router?
Josh: Yes. Emit routing.decision once at the router entry after evaluating local capacity and policy. Mark event.stage = decision and include request_token. Other services should reference that id.
Sam: Next steps: 1) Josh to spec routing.decision schema PR. 2) Anya to wire mockups for Tenant Route history + dry-run. 3) Kevin/Ops to draft strict-isolation gating rules + test plan. 4) Sam to add API header draft. Meet Fri 11am to align.
Tim: I'll add a console flag to surface the API header when doing ad-hoc requests.
Maria: can we add a small CSV export of recent spill events for compliance teams?
Sam: yes — include export in the dry-run modal.
Kevin: one more: model_variant fallback must be recorded: if hosted runs fallback variant (lower precision), show that in audit and in the exported CSV.
Sam: noted. That should be in the routing.decision.model_variant field.
Ops: sounds good. I'll start a runbook entry for "tenant spill to hosted" including SLAs and notification steps.
Sam: thanks all — will open the RFC with these action items and link the mockups + telemetry schema. :+1:
